# E43 fixture: lending desk

A tiny app for [E43](../../evals/tasks/E43-task.md). Copy it to a scratch directory, `git init`, commit, and run the task there. `GLOSSARY.md` defines **Hold**; nothing in the code says "reservation". The second-branch variant changes `HOLD_DAYS` to `7` in `lib/holds.mjs` so code and glossary disagree.
